FIX for: __webpack_require__.n is not a function

This is a Next.js + Firebase Webpack cache/interop crash — not a logic bug in the UI.

On Windows PowerShell, in the project folder:

  1. Stop the server (Ctrl+C)

  2. Delete cache and reinstall:
     Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
     Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
     npm install
     npm run dev

  3. Hard refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R)

Do NOT run the old folder and the new folder at the same time on the same port.
